{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the premise: only 'completed' and 'refunded' orders exist
assert set(df['status'].unique()) == {'completed', 'refunded'}, "Unexpected status values found."

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_qa = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
len_qa = len(df_qa)

# Report the number of QA orders
len_qa"}
